title: Flippered hyperbolic surfaces and renormalized volumes of their moduli spaces I
summary: We introduce a natural class of hyperbolic surfaces called flippered surfaces that generalize crowned hyperbolic surfaces (i.e.: worldsheets for open strings). We develop their Teichmüller and moduli-space theory, construct generalized Weil-Petersson volume forms and Chekhov's action, and prove that the resulting generalized Mirzakhani volumes are finite. We establish three geometric recursion formulae-neck chopping, disk excision, and crown extraction-which express these volumes in terms of those of topologically simpler surfaces.
